required_execution_conditions: Root alone runs exact1a1 read-only fresh preflight first with the final release path/hash. Require actual joined0/groupabsence/closedstreams and JSON status PASS_ACTUAL_FRESH_PREFLIGHT_READ_ONLY,predicate_passed true,mutation_started false,transaction_mutex_opened false,transaction_closed true,engine_execution_enabled false,no_cleanup_or_record_release true. Exit0 alone is insufficient.

Only after that positive closed preflight and fresh root sole-publisher admission may ONE cleanup run. Admission must cover current stop/usage/resource/storagefloors+fullgrowth+capture/emergency headroom/identity/UUID/no competing heavy or cleanup, CPU7 grant, inherited CPU(-1,-1), same permanent27:4, all preserved original inputs/records and seven fresh transaction/archive paths. No elapsed-time TTL is invented; all engine live checks rerun.

Engine retains independently reviewed freshpreflight before mutexcreation plus all original postlock/source/FD/census/ownership checks, both mutation latches,9-event journal,exact record exchanges/sentinel release and bounded quarantine diagnostics. Any refusal/quarantine is preserved and not replayed unchanged.

Cleanup/postjoin use exact ops roles and copiedbyteequal eff9 critical capture: directwaitFIRST,streamsclosed,groupabsence,full stableFD capturehashes,CPU7/FS128MiB/unlimitedCPU/no outertimeout or kill. AS2GiB cleanup; postjoin soft1GiB hard2GiB and original census temporarily2GiB.

Postjoin only after actual cleanup joined0/closedcaptures and exactbyte O_EXCL copy of cleanup stdout to actual-cleanup-result.json; use identical final release path/hash. Require full actual postjoin5members/journal9/archive2/currentCID+process census/all74native9 finite descriptors and all78selected+two complete inventories before/after readback.

No next heavy authority is issued here. Final physical acceptance requires actual positive cleanup/postjoin plus normal root same27:4 and related-process proof and exact four absences [lease,newQ,common,shared], from closed evidence in agreed existing0f832 schema.
scope: Exact current PASS-image finite terminal cleanup only; prior failed image/cleanup evidence remains preserved. Build/link acceptance is separately reviewed; no native app/runtime/ACK or whole Rust-retirement acceptance granted.
serialization_rule: Root inserts ONLY execution_review inline fields from this report with evidence_sha256 filled by actual report SHA; serialize/hash final release once and use identical path/bytes/hash for preflight, cleanup and postjoin. Only explicit release-hash placeholders in exact operations may be filled.
